name: Lamplight
description: A friendly help centre: a soft gradient search hero, four-up category cards with icons and question counts, popular questions and a contact band.
modelledOn: A customer-support software company’s help centre
features: Preset: help-centre — each category’s questions on its own page
Search hero with a gradient background and ⌘K
Category cards: icon, description, question count (4 per row)
Popular questions from the question’s own “Popular question” field
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

collections.name: Getting started
collections.description: Set up your account, invite your team and send the first reply.

pages.title: How do I create an account?
pages.markdown: Go to the sign-up page, enter your work email and choose a password. We send a confirmation link; once you click it, your workspace is ready and you land on the setup checklist.

pages.title: How do I invite teammates?
pages.markdown: Open **Settings → Team** and choose **Invite people**. Add one address per line and pick a role for each. Invitations stay valid for seven days, and you can resend one from the same list.

pages.title: How do I connect my support mailbox?
pages.markdown: In **Settings → Mailboxes**, choose **Connect a mailbox** and follow the forwarding steps for your email provider. New mail shows up in Your Brand within a minute of arriving.

collections.name: Billing and plans
collections.description: Plans, invoices, receipts and changing how you pay.

pages.title: How do I change my plan?
pages.markdown: Account owners can switch plans under **Settings → Billing**. An upgrade takes effect straight away and is prorated; a downgrade starts at your next renewal date.

pages.title: Where can I download an invoice?
pages.markdown: Every invoice is listed under **Settings → Billing → History**. Choose one to download a PDF that includes your company details and tax number.

pages.title: How do I update my payment card?
pages.markdown: Choose **Update payment method** on the billing page. The new card is used for the next charge; the old one is removed from our payment provider at the same time.

collections.name: Conversations
collections.description: Replying, assigning, tagging and keeping the queue moving.

pages.title: How do I assign a conversation to someone else?
pages.markdown: Open the conversation and pick a teammate from the **Assignee** menu at the top. They get a notification, and the conversation moves to their queue.

pages.title: Can I save replies I send often?
pages.markdown: Yes. Type the answer once, then choose **Save as reply** from the composer menu. Saved replies can include the customer’s first name and are shared with the whole team.

pages.title: What happens when I merge two conversations?
pages.markdown: The older conversation is folded into the newer one, keeping every message in order. Tags and notes from both are kept, and the customer sees nothing change.

collections.name: Account and security
collections.description: Passwords, two-step sign-in and who can see what.

pages.title: How do I turn on two-step sign-in?
pages.markdown: Go to **Profile → Security** and choose **Turn on two-step sign-in**. Scan the code with an authenticator app and enter the six digits it shows to finish.

pages.title: I forgot my password. What now?
pages.markdown: Choose **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page and enter your email. The reset link is valid for one hour; if it does not arrive, check your spam folder first.
